answer: A workable design: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The fable of work and the vine of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a jetty to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
